patchouli.merlins_inferno.guide.landing_: A grimoire for the road ahead - Lyrium and Seraphium, the Hell Forge, Rowanwood and Demonblood, the Druid's trade, and whatever else this land has decided to curse you with.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.guide.subtitle: Merlin's Inferno: Requiem
patchouli.merlins_inferno.category.getti: The basics - what to look for, and where to begin.
$(bold)Merlin's Inferno: Requiem$()$(br2)This grimoire grows as you uncover what this land hides: three lineages of equipment, the Lyrium refinement chain, the Hell Forge, the Druid's trade, and the things that hunt you along the way.$(br2)Each road has its own chapter.
advancements.merlins_inferno.root.title: Merlin's Inferno: Requiem
advancements.merlins_inferno.root.descri: Survive the inferno. Conquer the unknown.
advancements.merlins_inferno.obtain_demo: «Lasciate ogne speranza, voi ch'intrate.» Obtain a full suit of Demonblood armor.
advancements.merlins_inferno.obtain_rowa: «Fear not, till Birnam wood do come to Dunsinane.» Obtain a full suit of Rowanwood armor.
advancements.merlins_inferno.obtain_sera: «Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand.» Obtain a full suit of Seraphium armor.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.category.druid: The Hallowed Grove, its trees, the Druid, the Dullahan and Rowanwood.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.category.infer: Imps, the Hell Forge and Demonblood.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.category.angel: Lyrium, its geodes, the Sanctified curse and Seraphium.
Three lineages of equipment, one for each origin:$(br2)$(bold)Overworld$() - the Druid's Rowanwood, from the Hallowed Grove.$(br)$(bold)Demonic$() - Demonblood, forged in the Nether.$(br)$(bold)Angelical$() - Seraphium, born of Lyrium.

Each one is its own road. Rowanwood is sturdy and wise; Demonblood matches Netherite and hates humankind; Seraphium is the strongest of the three, and the hardest to earn.$(br2)The next chapters follow each road.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.hallowed: $(bold)The Hallowed Grove$()$(br2)A temperate, humid forest with a faint cool tint. Two trees grow here: the common $(bold)Ashwood$(), good for building, and the rare, towering $(bold)Rowanwood$().
Look for a $(bold)Druid's Sanctuary$(): a round clearing ringed by wooden pillars, a hearth with a fire, a chest, and a Druid keeping watch.$(br2)/locate structure merlins_inferno:druid_sanctuary
$(bold)Beware the night.$()$(br2)After dark, something walks the Grove: the Dullahan. He stays until the dawn - or until nobody is left in the Grove to hunt.
The Grove's common wood. Any axe cuts it, and it makes the whole set: planks, stairs, slabs, fence and gate, door, trapdoor, button, pressure plate, signs and hanging signs, plus stripped logs.$(br2)It is purely for building; no gear needs it.
Hanging signs need stripped logs: strip one with an axe.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.rowanwoo: $(bold)Rowanwood$()$(br2)The mystical tree: taller than any other, and rare - a landmark in the Grove. Its log is as hard as obsidian.
Any axe can cut it, slowly. Without $(bold)Druid's Touch$() it takes twice as long and yields only plain Ashwood. With the enchantment you get the real thing: Rowanwood logs.
Either essence works. Then smelt the scrap.
Mundane Essence comes from the Druids; Fae Essence from the Dullahan.

Rowanwood gear mines like Diamond but hits like Iron, with Gold's enchantability and more durability than Diamond.$(br2)It bites harder against magical creatures (+30%), and struggles against plain animals (-30%).
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.druid.pa: $(bold)The Druid$()$(br2)A guardian spirit of the Grove. Peaceful: he won't attack you, even if struck. He hunts the undead on sight - all but the Dullahan, from whom he flees.
Trade with him: $(bold)20 emeralds$() for a $(bold)Mundane Essence$(), the catalyst that turns raw Rowanwood into a set.$(br2)His trade wears out, but refills every day.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.dullahan: $(bold)The Dullahan$()$(br2)A headless knight who rides the Grove at night on a spectral black steed, his head under one arm and a spine for a whip. Strong - half a Warden - and his whip outreaches a sword. Kill the horse and he fights on foot.
$(bold)He fears gold.$()$(br2)Drop a gold ingot near him and he freezes for a few seconds, taking extra damage. It isn't required to win - but it is the smart way.
Slain, he leaves 2-3 $(bold)Fae Essence$() - which, like Mundane Essence, turns Rowanwood into a set.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.druids_t: A wide-reaching enchantment that works on any tool:$(br2)$(bold)Pickaxe$() - more Redstone and Lapis.$(br)$(bold)Sword$() - more XP and gold; magical creatures drop double.$(br)$(bold)Axe$() - unlocks Rowanwood.
Look for it in the chests of Druid sanctuaries - or, rarely, on the enchanting table at high levels.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.imp.name: The Imp
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.imp.page: $(bold)The Imp$()$(br2)A small flying demon of the Nether. It wants your gold more than it wants a fight: alone, or in pairs, it flees from you.
In packs of three or more it grows bold and dives at you in turns. It snatches gold - from the ground, from your hand, or golden gear from a piglin's hand. Hit it and it drops what it carries.
Imps drop $(bold)Demon Blood$() (30%, more with Looting) and a little gold.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.infernal: $(bold)Demon Blood$() - dropped by Imps.$(br)$(bold)Infernal Essence$() - a rare find when bartering with piglins.$(br)$(bold)Infernal Sinew$() - taken from piglins.$(br)$(bold)Withered Bone$() - taken from wither skeletons.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.hell_for: Compressed Netherrack, for the forge itself.

It burns $(bold)Lava Buckets$() or $(bold)Blaze Powder$() into a fuel tank, cooks 30% faster than a furnace, and takes anything a furnace or blast furnace can. It is the only place Demonblood Scrap becomes a bar.$(br2)It is big - give it room. Right-click any of its blocks to open it.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.demonblo: 4 Netherite Scrap, 4 Demon Blood and 1 Infernal Essence make 2 scraps.
Take the scrap to a $(bold)Hell Forge$() to smelt it into a Demonblood Bar. A furnace can't do it.

Demonblood gear matches Netherite, with better enchantability. Weapons come with Bane of Humanity I and hit humans (villagers, illagers, witches) for 10% more.$(br2)$(bold)Demon's Fury$() (armor): fire damage halved and hostile mobs' damage cut by a quarter - but neutral mobs hurt 25% more (full set).
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.lyrium.p: $(bold)Lyrium$()$(br2)Dangerous and unstable. Raw Lyrium forms in geodes high in the mountains, like amethyst, and as rare, scattered ores, like emerald.
$(bold)Stages$()$(br2)Raw, Impure, Refined, Pure, True. Only the first three can be reached so far.
Smelting Raw Lyrium makes it safe to carry.
$(bold)Refined Lyrium$(): trade with a master-level Cleric - 9 Impure Lyrium or 27 diamonds for one - or find it, rarely, as contraband in pillager loot.
Shards and a rod, for Seraphium tools.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.geodes.p: A geode of calcite and basalt, lined with Lyrium Block and studded with Lyrium Clusters, hides in the mountains. It blazes at full brightness.

Its light burns the unholy: $(bold)undead and demons within 16 blocks are Sanctified$() - level II around the geode, level IV inside it.$(br2)A geode is finite: nothing regrows. And blocks you place yourself lose that power - only the world's own geodes radiate.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.sanctifi: $(bold)Sanctified$()$(br2)Raw Lyrium's touch. It burns like poison - and it can kill you, even outside Hardcore.
Carry Raw Lyrium in your inventory: level I. Hold it in a hand: level III, and one level more each minute, up to V. It takes a second to take hold, and a second to fade.

A Sanctified bearer strikes undead harder (+2.5 damage per level, like Smite) and passes the effect to whatever they hit in melee.$(br2)Only players can spread it: a mob that catches it does not pass it on.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.seraphiu: 4 Diamonds, 4 Refined Lyrium and 1 Celestial Essence make 3 scraps.
$(bold)Celestial Essence$()$(br2)Dropped by Elias, who keeps vigil in the Sacred Churches of the mountains. See his entry.

Seraphium is the strongest of the three sets. Every blow Sanctifies its target (level II against undead).$(br2)Damage: demons x1.5, hostile mobs x1.3, neutral x0.75, peaceful x0.5. Its wrath is meant for evil.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.sacred_c: $(bold)The Sacred Church$()$(br2)A vast gothic church standing alone in the mountains, its nave and transepts laid out in the shape of a cross. Rare: you will have to look for it (/locate structure merlins_inferno:sacred_church).

Robed $(bold)Sacred Cultists$() kneel in the nave. They are neutral - leave them be and they leave you be. Strike one and the whole congregation turns on you.$(br2)A chest waits in the north transept.

On the chancel kneels $(bold)Elias$(). Above the crossing hangs the $(bold)Great Bell$().$(br2)Once he has fallen, a $(bold)diamond$() laid on the altar wakes another - but not before a full day has passed.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.elias.pa: $(bold)Elias, the Last Prophet$()$(br2)Not an angel: a zealot broken by the Lyrium he worships, blindfold on, dragging a censer on a chain. Slow, but strong - half a Warden - and the chain reaches farther than it looks.

$(bold)The Great Bell.$()$(br2)While you fight, the bell tolls once a minute. Every toll makes him stronger and lets him heal, but he takes more damage too. On the seventh toll, or when he falls below a third of his health, the bell breaks and he turns furious: faster, harder-hitting, no longer healing.
$(bold)His touch$() Sanctifies you, a level higher with every blow (milk cures it). When the bell breaks he goes into a fury.$(br2)Slain, he leaves 2-3 $(bold)Celestial Essence$().
message.merlins_inferno.sacred_altar.hin: Lay a diamond on the altar to keep the vigil.
message.merlins_inferno.sacred_altar.coo: The altar is still cold. Return in %s minute(s).
message.merlins_inferno.elias.fury: The bell shatters! Elias is furious.
message.merlins_inferno.sacred_altar.gua: The Sacred Priest still guards this church.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.sacred_p: $(bold)The Sacred Priest$()$(br2)Guardian of the Sacred Church. Neutral, like his flock - leave him be and he leaves you be, and his cultists rally to him the moment he is struck.$(br2)Elias cannot be woken at the altar until the Priest has fallen. Slain, he leaves 2-4 $(bold)Lyrium Shards$().
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.andras.p: $(bold)Andras, the Forgotten Demon$()$(br2)A lesser demon, the Nether's overseer: he calls Imps to his side and treats the Starved as a tool. Rare and solitary - you will have to search the Nether for him.
Every blow he lands brands you with the $(bold)Mark of Debt$(): more damage taken while it lasts. Slain, he leaves the $(bold)Book of Contracts$() - a key to Pandora's Box.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.ancient_: $(bold)The Ancient Battlefield$()$(br2)A floating island in the Nether where a forgotten war was fought - flesh, skulls and rubble around a ritual circle. Imps and Grymns still rise from the ruins, and the rubble hides chests of fortress-grade loot.

Andras waits on the glass dome under a giant $(bold)sword$(). Its core is Corrupted Obsidian: a portal his key will open. Beneath the dome, a sealed crypt guards the richest treasure - and a pit of lava.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.ostara.p: $(bold)Ostara, the Spring Deity$()$(br2)Patron of the Hallowed Grove's spring. She walks only at dawn, every third day, beneath a Rowanwood tree - and is gone by dusk. She flings withering petals from afar and mends the beasts around her.
Slain, she leaves $(bold)Eve's Secret$() - a key to Pandora's Box.
item.merlins_inferno.pandora_box_tooltip: The Book of Contracts, Eve's Secret and the Flame of God open it, with a Nether Star.
Once opened, it never leaves you - not even to death.
item.merlins_inferno.oblivion_key_toolti: Lights a portal to Oblivion in a Void Block frame, like flint and steel. Oblivion is empty and lightless, waiting to be built upon.
item.merlins_inferno.purgatory_key_toolt: Awakens the dormant portal where Andras once stood watch.
item.merlins_inferno.portal_key_dormant: The portal itself does not exist yet.
gui.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.warning: This will end you - the Box will remain
message.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.inco: The three keys and a Nether Star are needed.
message.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.open: The Box opens. Circle 2 awaits - beyond death.
message.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.key_: The ingredients for that key are missing.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.pandora_: $(bold)Pandora's Box$()$(br2)Found, rarely, in a Sacred Church's chest. Lay the three Circle 1 bosses' keys around it with a Nether Star, and perform the ritual.
The centre swallows the rest - and you. Outside Hardcore, the ritual costs your life; the Box itself never leaves you, not even then. Circle 2 opens either way.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.grymn.pa: $(bold)The Grymn$()$(br2)A ghost the shape of a phantom, drifting just above the Nether's floor. It lurks alone in the deep, dark reaches, waiting - and it only ever hunts $(bold)players$().

It never flees and never rises out of reach: it stays low, close to the ground, then comes straight for you. Tough and hard-hitting for a first miniboss, so do not let it corner you.$(br2)It drops $(bold)Demon Blood$() (70%), $(bold)Withered Bone$(), $(bold)Infernal Essence$() and sometimes $(bold)Infernal Sinew$() (35%) - and, from Circle 2 on, $(bold)Otherworld Essence$().
$(bold)The Starved$()$(br2)A demon that never finished forming, stuck in a hunger that cannot be sated. Where the Imp is small and craven, the Starved is large, four-legged and relentless. Once you have opened Circle 2, it prowls the Nether in numbers.

It never flees, and if it loses you it walks to where it last saw you. Every few seconds it goes without landing a hit, its $(bold)Hunger$() grows: it becomes faster and hits harder. Land a bite and it feeds - hunger resets and it heals.

Once truly hungry it winds up a charge - roaring in place before it dashes in a straight line. Step aside. Finish the fight quickly.$(br2)It drops $(bold)Demon Blood$() (70%), $(bold)Devil Flesh$() (60%) and sometimes $(bold)Infernal Sinew$() (12%). Two $(bold)Withered Bones$() and a Devil Flesh make an Infernal Sinew.
gui.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.opened_h: Void Block in the center + 16 each of Otherworld, Infernal and Celestial Essence: Oblivion.
gui.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.ritual_h: Nether Star in the center. Around it: Book of Contracts, Eve's Secret and Flame of God.
gui.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.warning_: Opens Circle 2. Consumes ingredients. This mode spares your life.
gui.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.purgator: Book of Contracts in the center + 3 Netherite Ingots, 16 Infernal Essence and 16 Otherworld Essence in the orbit.
gui.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.catalyst: The central item determines the recipe.
gui.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.offering: The order of offerings does not matter.
gui.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.second_c: Opens the Second Circle; this ritual does not produce an item.
gui.merlins_inferno.pandora_box.take_res: Take the result from the center before forging again.
effect.merlins_inferno.druidic_trance.de: Slower, weaker and clumsy at mining - but hardly any harm reaches you. You are always hungry; food fills you twice as much and mends you. The Grove's hidden things show through the walls.
Slower, weaker and clumsy at mining - but hardly any harm reaches you. You are always hungry; food fills you twice as much and mends you. The Grove's hidden things show through the walls.
patchouli.merlins_inferno.entry.edenweed: $(bold)Edenweed$()$(br2)A shrub of serrated leaves that grows only at the roots of the Grove's Rowanwood trees, faintly glowing. Right-click it when it is full-grown to pick its buds - it grows back.

Raw buds do little. Hang them on a $(bold)Drying Rack$() and, after a couple of minutes, they become $(bold)Dried Edenweed$().$(br2)Smoke it in a $(bold)Wooden Pipe$(), or boil it into a $(bold)Tea$() with a bottle of water.

$(bold)Druidic Trance$()$(br2)You move and mine slowly, and hit weakly - but you take 80% less damage. Hunger gnaws at you; whatever you eat fills you twice as much and mends you.$(br2)And you see: ores, chests and the Grove's spirits show through the walls.
